name: marketing-loops

en.description: Set up a recurring, self-running marketing workflow — a repeatable loop an AI agent runs on a cadence (weekly, daily, on a trigger) rather than a one-off task.

zh-CN.description: 把营销任务设计为定期或按条件触发的可重复工作流，并明确观察指标和停止条件。

runtime: No helper runtime required; web, analytics, media, or account tools are optional and task-dependent

stableBlockers: Run blind review on three representative real tasks
Validate platform-specific guidance and external-action recovery
